claim.claim-text: 2. The stent delivery system (10; 100; 200) of claim 1, wherein the actuation assembly comprises a thumb wheel (210), a pinion (212), and a rack assembly (215).

3. The stent delivery system (10; 100; 200) of claim 2, wherein the rack assembly (215) comprises an outer tubular member (214) and an inner tubular member (232) slidably disposed within the outer tubular member (214).
4. The stent delivery system (10; 100; 200) of claim 3, wherein the proximal end region of the inner sheath (26; 126; 244) is fixedly secured to the inner tubular member (232).
5. The stent delivery system (10; 100; 200) of any one of claim 3-4, wherein the proximal end region of the outer sheath (22; 122; 240) is fixedly secured to the outer tubular member (214).

6. The stent delivery system (10; 100; 200) of any one of claims 3-5, wherein the outer tubular member (214) includes a slot (218) extending from an outer surface to an inner surface of the outer tubular member (214), the slot (218) having proximal end (222), a distal end (220), and a pushing element (234) disposed adjacent the distal end (220).

7. The stent delivery system (10; 100; 200) of claim 6, wherein the inner tubular member (232) includes an enlarged region (224) having a proximal end (222) and a distal end (220), the enlarged region (224) configured to extend into the slot (218) of the outer tubular member (214).

8. The stent delivery system (10; 100; 200) of claim 7, wherein the enlarged region (224) of the inner tubular member (232) includes a plurality of teeth and grooves (230) formed in an outer surface thereof.

9. The stent delivery system (10; 100; 200) of claim 8, wherein the plurality of teeth and grooves (230) of the inner tubular member (232) generally radially align with a plurality of teeth and grooves (216) on an outer surface of the outer tubular member (214).

10. The stent delivery system (10; 100; 200) of any one of claims 3-7, wherein rotation of the thumb wheel (210) is configured to proximally retract the outer tubular member (214) independently of the inner tubular member (232) over a first distance.

11. The stent delivery system (10; 100; 200) of claim 10, wherein further rotation of the thumb wheel (210) is configured to proximally retract the outer tubular member (214) and the inner tubular member (232) simultaneously over a second distance.
12. The stent delivery system (10; 100; 200) of any one of claims 1-11, wherein the lubricant (30; 130; 248; 310) comprises a solid lubricant.
13. The stent delivery system (10; 100; 200) of any one of claims 1-12, wherein the lubricant (30; 130; 248; 310) comprises graphene sheets.
14. The stent delivery system (10; 100; 200) of any one of claims 1-11, wherein the lubricant (30; 130; 248; 310) comprises a liquid lubricant or an embedded lubricant.
15. The stent delivery system (10; 100; 200) of any one of claims 1-14, wherein the stent (16; 116; 250) is self-expanding.
